# Munari

> Munari renders live, interactive DOM as physical matter in Three.js. It uses Chrome's experimental HTML-in-Canvas API and keeps the DOM as the source of truth.

## Start in the version you are using

- [README and package setup](README.md)
- [Munari agent skill](.agents/skills/munari/SKILL.md)

In a checkout, confirm the repository, branch and dirty scope, then choose a
task route below. In an installed package, read its index.d.ts and advanced.d.ts
for exact APIs. The package currently ships the two guides above, not the full
repository docs or registry. Obtain missing guidance from a proven matching
release revision; do not substitute mutable main as version-local truth.

## Repository task routes (checkout only)

- [Task → owner → control → proof](docs/agent-workflow.md)
- [System model and evidence boundaries](docs/system-model.md)
- [Shared terms](CONTEXT.md)
- [DOM authoring rules](docs/authoring.md)
- [Current public React exports](packages/react/src/index.ts)
- [Current advanced exports](packages/react/src/advanced.ts)
- [Copyable recipes](registry/README.md)
- [Lab scene contracts](apps/lab/README.md)
- [Browser gates and limits](instruments/README.md)

## Read only when the task needs it (checkout only)

- [Canonical document map and status](docs/README.md)
- [Numbered handoff decisions and amendments](docs/decisions.md)
- [Dated platform measurements](docs/platform.md)
- [Conformance specification](tests/conformance/README.md)
- [Agent system delivery plan: proposed, not shipped](docs/agent-system-plan.md)

The Revision 3 proposal and compound sketches are design history. Use current
exported types for signatures. Treat a capability skip as untested behavior.
